label: Washing machine

questions.text: How many washes does it run in a week?
questions.why: More washes mean more wear on the motor, drum bearings and belts.

questions.text: Is the drum usually filled to the top?
questions.why: Overloading strains the motor and bearings.

questions.text: Does the machine shake or move during the spin?
questions.why: An unlevel machine shakes and wears faster.

questions.text: How often is the lint or drain filter cleaned?
questions.why: A blocked filter slows draining and spoils washes.

answers.label: Never / don't know where it is

questions.text: Does your water leave white marks on taps and buckets?
questions.why: Hard water leaves scale that affects heating and the drum.

questions.text: Does the power at home often dip, flicker or trip?
questions.why: Unsteady power can damage the electronics.

questions.text: Have you noticed leaks, a burning smell, error codes or water not draining?
questions.why: Early signs let you get it checked before a small fault grows.

care_tips.text: Switch off and unplug the washing machine before cleaning it.
care_tips.why: Cleaning an appliance that is plugged in risks an electric shock.

care_tips.text: Don't open the washing machine yourself; leave repairs to the brand's authorised service.
care_tips.why: Inside there are live parts, and opening it can also end the warranty.

care_tips.text: Fill the drum to about three-quarters, not to the top.
care_tips.why: Overloading strains the motor and drum bearings.

care_tips.text: Keep the machine level and on a firm floor.
care_tips.why: A level machine shakes less and lasts longer.

care_tips.text: Clean the lint or drain filter as your manual describes.
care_tips.why: A clean filter helps the water drain.

care_tips.text: Leave the door or lid open after a wash so the inside can dry.
care_tips.why: This stops smells and mould on the seal.

care_tips.text: In hard-water areas, run a drum clean cycle as your manual suggests.
care_tips.why: Scale builds up on the heater and drum.

care_tips.text: Use a stabilizer or surge protector if the power is unsteady.
care_tips.why: Power swings can damage the control board.

care_tips.text: If it leaks, smells burnt, shows error codes or stops draining, switch it off and contact the brand's service.
care_tips.why: Running it with a fault can make the damage worse.

reminders.text: Clean the washing machine's lint or drain filter.
reminders.note: Check your manual for the interval for your model.

reminders.text: Run a drum clean or empty hot wash.
reminders.note: Check your manual for the interval for your model.
